title: 鹊桥仙（纤云弄巧）
titleEn: Immortals at the Magpie Bridge (Fine Clouds Weave Their Patterns)
author: 秦观
intro: The Cowherd and the Weaver Girl can meet only once a year, on a bridge of magpies across the Milky Way. Instead of pitying them, this lyric argues that true love doesn’t need to be together every day.
analysis: 这首词写的是七夕节的传说：天上的织女和人间的牛郎相爱，却被银河隔开，每年只有农历七月七日晚上，喜鹊搭成桥，他们才能见一面。上阕写相会：轻柔的云彩变出巧妙的花样，流星传递着离别的愁恨，他们悄悄渡过遥远的银河。在秋风白露的夜晚见上一面，就胜过人间无数次的相聚。下阕写分别：温柔的感情像水一样，美好的相会像梦一样短，怎么忍心回头看鹊桥上回去的路？最后两句是千古名句：只要两个人的感情长久不变，又何必天天在一起呢？别的诗写七夕多是悲伤，这首词却翻出新意，把离别写得深情又豁达。今天“两情若是久长时，又岂在朝朝暮暮”仍常被用来说异地恋。
analysisEn: The lyric retells the legend behind Qixi, the Chinese Valentine’s Day. The Weaver Girl, a goddess, fell in love with a mortal cowherd, but the Milky Way was set between them; only on the seventh night of the seventh lunar month do magpies form a bridge so the lovers can meet. The first half is the meeting. Delicate clouds weave clever patterns, shooting stars carry the sorrow of separation, and the two quietly cross the vast River of Heaven. One meeting on a night of golden autumn wind and jade-white dew is worth more than countless meetings in the human world. The second half is the parting. Their tenderness flows like water, the reunion passes like a dream, and they can hardly bear to look back at the road home across the bridge. Then come the famous closing lines: if love is meant to last, why must the lovers be together every morning and every evening? Most Qixi poems dwell on the sadness; Qin Guan turns it around into something warm and open-hearted. People still quote these lines to couples living far apart.
background: Qin Guan (1049–1100) was one of the four famous disciples of Su Shi and a master of the gentle, lyrical style of Song song lyrics. Caught up in his teacher’s political fall, he spent his last years in exile in the far south.
pronunciation: “纤云”的“纤”读 xiān，不读 qiàn。迢迢 tiáo tiáo。“胜却”的“胜”读 shèng。“朝朝暮暮”的“朝”读 zhāo（早晨），不读 cháo。“暗度”的“度”同“渡”。
version: 采用通行文本（《淮海居士长短句》）。“银汉迢迢暗度”有的本子作“暗渡”，意思相同。

lines.py: xiān yún nòng qiǎo, fēi xīng chuán hèn
lines.lit: Fine clouds play at clever shapes; flying stars carry sorrow;
lines.en: Wisps of cloud weave their fine designs, shooting stars carry the ache of parting,

lines.py: yín hàn tiáo tiáo àn dù
lines.lit: the silver River, far and wide, is secretly crossed.
lines.en: as the lovers slip across the endless Silver River.

lines.py: jīn fēng yù lù yī xiāng féng
lines.lit: Golden wind and jade dew: one meeting
lines.en: One meeting in the golden wind and jade-white dew

lines.py: biàn shèng què rén jiān wú shù
lines.lit: then surpasses countless ones in the human world.
lines.en: is worth more than countless meetings down on earth.

lines.py: róu qíng sì shuǐ, jiā qī rú mèng
lines.lit: Tender feelings like water; the happy meeting like a dream;
lines.en: Their tenderness flows like water, their night together passes like a dream;

lines.py: rěn gù què qiáo guī lù
lines.lit: how bear to look back at the magpie bridge, the road home?
lines.en: how can they bear to look back at the road home across the magpie bridge?

lines.py: liǎng qíng ruò shì jiǔ cháng shí
lines.lit: If the two hearts are long-lasting,
lines.en: If two hearts are meant to last,

lines.py: yòu qǐ zài zhāo zhāo mù mù
lines.lit: how does it depend on every morning and every evening?
lines.en: why must they be together morning after morning, night after night?

words.note: 纤：细小，今天“纤细”“纤维”还用。
今天成语“弄巧成拙”的意思不同，是贬义。

words.en: the Silver River — the Milky Way

words.note: 书面语仍用，如“千里迢迢”。

words.en: golden wind and jade dew — autumn
words.note: 古人认为秋天属“金”，所以秋风叫金风。

words.en: to surpass; to be better than

words.note: 现代汉语仍用，如“柔情似水”是常用成语。

words.en: how can one bear to look back
words.note: 忍：怎么忍心；顾：回头看，今天“回顾”“顾盼”还用。
今天比喻牵线搭桥、介绍婚姻，如“搭鹊桥”。
反问语气，书面语仍用，如“岂有此理”。
今天仍用，指天天在一起。

imagery.name: 牵牛织女
imagery.zh: 牛郎织女一年只见一次，作者却借他们说明：真正的爱情不在于天天相守。
imagery.en: The lovers meet once a year, yet the poet uses them to argue that true love doesn’t depend on daily company.

imagery.name: 银河
imagery.zh: 迢迢银河是分开两人的距离，越难越过，相会越珍贵。
imagery.en: The wide Milky Way is the distance between them — the harder it is to cross, the more precious the meeting.

imagery.name: 露
imagery.zh: “玉露”写七夕秋夜的清凉纯净，衬托相会的美好。
imagery.en: Jade-white dew gives the autumn night a cool purity that suits the lovers’ meeting.

imagery.name: 云
imagery.zh: 云彩变出巧妙的花样，像织女的手艺，为相会布置舞台。
imagery.en: Clouds weaving clever patterns echo the Weaver Girl’s craft and set the stage for the meeting.
